purpose: Preparation only; no runtime acceptance inferred from desktop status. Compare latest shipping Electron before implementation.

features.contract: Resting pill shows back/forward (desktop; mobile uses edge-swipe per D7), standalone-pin + active-section dots (cap 8 + window-wide `+N`; pointer platforms reveal a dot's favicon on hover/focus), favicon, domain, shield count (clickable → site-protection popover on desktop), private chip, action cluster. Expanded states: panel / palette / find. Desktop has opt-in 300 ms hover-open and an opt-in auto-hiding strip; touch-only mobile has no hover equivalent.

Same lifecycle + same reopen-closed and pin/mute semantics. Desktop recovery is scoped to the native workspace that closed the tab (D11). Pins remain in their current group and lead it; ungrouped pins use a standalone shelf. Plain new tab is always ungrouped. An inactive tab may have its renderer discarded and rebuilt (D8, F31) without losing identity, title, address, or back-history.

Names (with an optional Spaces preset color), kept in the case typed and matched in any case; renamable from the header. Group exists only while non-empty. Pill renders standalone pins + the active section and counts every omitted tab in `+N`. Same create/move/ungroup/close-group actions.
Never in history/session/reopen; inherited by child tabs; isolated non-persistent web session; private theme + quick-exit chip.

Same normalization heuristic + engine choice (DuckDuckGo/Google/Bing/Brave/Kagi, or a custom address). Best-effort autocomplete follows the current default; opt-out, private tabs, pasted/dropped text, local paths, URL-like input, and credential-like prefixes stay local. OS hand-off for `mailto:`/`tel:`/etc.; desktop additionally confirms reviewed app/OAuth callback schemes.
⌘L-equivalent summons it; loose/in-order match across tabs, favorites, history, group names; groups ranked above tabs.
Shared commands keep identical names + hints; `/1password` is available only on desktop under D26.
Capsule over content, match nav, page stays interactive.
Heart toggle, "Add all open tabs", favorites page + newtab favorites. Internal id stays `bookmarks`.
Per-visit record + title update, capped 5000, clearable, excluded for private tabs.
Downloads list UI + progress, capped 200.
Ads/trackers blocked by default; per-tab shield count; per-site allow and re-block from the same command; shield chip opens a site-protection popover (desktop); global toggle. Filter data shared.
Explicit per-permission prompts with the same policy/copy.

Same shared keys, defaults, and validation (search engine, device-local `searchSuggestions`, adblock, home page, theme, app icon, exceptions, usage measurement, supporter); desktop alone exposes F38's device-local 1Password toggle/account routing value.
system/light/dark + private scope; propagates to chrome, internal pages, web content live, no restart.
newtab ledger, favorites, history, downloads, settings, shortcuts, error — same content/copy; utility pages present as a transient chrome surface (desktop: sheet), never tabs.
Three current colorways (Sunrise, Sunrise Dark, Sunrise Gold); Patron is optional support and unlocks nothing; Blanc Spaces (F41) is free.

Restore tabs + groups; private tabs excluded; same `session.json` shape (adapted per platform store). Plus an optional per-tab title/favicon `meta` column so restored tabs are scannable before they load.
Same actions (open in new/background tab, copy link, etc.); OS hand-off honored.
No platform shows its own credentials dialog for HTTP Basic/Digest or proxy challenges; the challenged request fails, and the page can observe the 401/407 response where the browser permits.

A fresh profile must commit its on/off choice before any event; the choice is presented on by default and remains device-local. When enabled, packaged desktop builds send one launch event plus once-per-session fixed metrics for the first Mahjong move and each rendered start-page layout. Desktop 1.31.0+ also sends two once-per-install first-day signals (default browser; three web pages opened) used only for next-day return. Private tabs and browsing/game content are excluded.
User gets updates; no in-app updater fighting the OS store.
Page can be scaled; desktop discrete zoom vs mobile pinch/native reflow.
On mobile, native credential provider + platform passkeys work in-webview.

Per-device opt-in, off by default, publish-only gating; read-only browsing in panel/switcher/start page; http(s)-only bounded snapshots plus a separately-budgeted E2EE icon sidecar; retraction + 30-day prune + 24 h heartbeat. Optional favicons are inert bounded PNG bytes—never remote URLs loaded by a receiving device. Desktop adds device pairing with a ten-minute code (one-shot Worker route) and a clipboard recovery code, and synced device names (Rename Device…, Settings → Sync); mobile pending.

The logical tabs/groups and their identity, lifecycle, private/media state, and organization remain available. Desktop may present them in an optional persistent rail without replacing the Island or reloading content; mobile uses its native tab overview.
Explicit, bounded, add-only import of supported web Favorites; folders preserved where available, retries deduplicated, and no implicit import of passwords/history/cookies/sessions.

An idle background tab may have its renderer discarded and rebuilt on return with identity, title, address, and back-history intact; the page is reloaded, never resumed. Never applied to the active tab, media-bearing or muted tabs, pins, unsaved input, non-refetchable commits, pending permission prompts, opener families, or deep-scrolled pages. Restored sessions come back quiet. The state is called "quiet" in every user-visible and assistive string.
Each desktop native window owns an isolated tab/group/surface workspace; close removes only that secondary workspace, and relaunch restores all persisted windows without mixing tabs.

Personal retains every existing root record; each named desktop profile isolates site storage, Favorites/history/download metadata/permissions, normal browsing, and private browsing. Device settings stay shared and Profile Sync remains Personal-only.

A desktop window can show one explicitly chosen local tab as a temporary reference; dismissal leaves the tab open, and ownership never crosses a window or profile. Unreleased on main since v1.39.0: the reference is a movable, resizable card floating over the page (Open as tab replaces Make main's swap; a tab switch closes it).

Four layouts (ledger/billboard/shelf/tally), chosen by a synced setting with an in-page Customize popover; Billboard ranks local history by hostname, shows short site names (full titles as tooltips), reuses locally captured favicon pixels, and keeps dismissals in localStorage only; per-day blocked counts feed the tally chart; every footer opens Mahjong in its own managed tab; no horizontal overflow at any width.

A six-step walkthrough shown once to fresh profiles (default browser, import, island, blocking, privacy, theme); privacy consent gates its network features, import keeps F30's explicit discovery, and both successful-import and skip paths can hand off to F40 without making full import a prerequisite. Replayable from Settings. Default-browser registration and live profile import are desktop surfaces (D22).

features.feature: Blank tab shows where to type
features.contract: A blank tab's island reads as a text field (prompt in placeholder ink, plus a commands affordance that opens the command list) and typing on the blank tab begins entry in the island. The *contract* is product-level and portable; its desktop expression — a caret, a `/` chip, and a hardware-keyboard type-to-open path — is not. Mobile satisfies it with a tap target and the platform keyboard; there is no physical-keyboard gate to port.

Desktop (macOS, Windows, Linux), off-by-default explicit bridge to the user's installed 1Password app/account; Windows/Linux real-account validation pending; saved-website behavior and a revalidated login form bound the fill; no Blanc credential store, background lookup, renderer IPC, persistence, sync, or telemetry.

A selected Chromium-family profile's newest verified restorable open-tab session becomes reviewed, ordered quiet tabs and editable Named Groups. Duplicate tabs, pins, source windows, and eligible named source groups are preserved; Favorites remain separate. Any quit request is normal, user-initiated, and gated by recoverability preflight plus exact newest-session verification.

Desktop only. Named, profile-scoped sets of a window's tabs and groups that swap in place and autosave; each has a colour and symbol shown as the Island's space mark; free for everyone; at most 25 per profile; never synced.

Off by default, device-local. While Blanc is dark, http(s) pages without their own dark mode are darkened from first paint by the pinned Dark Reader engine in an isolated world; per-site opt-out via Settings, `/dark-site` or the shield popover switch (memory-only in private tabs). Desktop is PARTIAL: main frames only, iframes stay as drawn.

All Blanc-authored UI text from the shared catalog; fixed brand/command terms; English fallback; user may pin a supported language other than the OS's; web-facing language signals unaffected. Desktop: in-app picker + relaunch; mobile: OS per-app language.

Desktop only. Arc's StorableSidebar.json (found on macOS/Windows, or a chosen file anywhere) becomes one Blanc space per Arc Space, in one all-or-nothing write; folders become groups, tabs stay quiet, top-row Favorites join an Arc folder. The page sees only names and counts.

Desktop only. A tab may carry the person's own name instead of its page title; it survives navigation, relaunch, Spaces and reopen, never reaches History or Favorites, and is memory-only for private tabs.

`!code words` searches one site directly for every search engine, from Kagi's pinned open list; a hint row and a `!` picker in the command bar; a synced switch and the person's own bangs in Settings; no suggestion request for bang-shaped text; recents device-local and never from private tabs. The pure module and catalog under `bangs/` are the shared substrate.

Desktop only. A pinned tab keeps browsing normally for the session, returns to the page where it was pinned after a clean relaunch, restores the last page after a crash, and changes home only through explicit pin or menu actions. Homes stay local and private-tab homes are memory-only.

Desktop only. A JPEG or PNG the person chooses is downscaled, stripped of metadata except orientation, stored on this device only (never synced, never in private tabs) and served at an unguessable per-launch address.
Desktop only. Soft, solid or gradient from the eight Spaces presets, synced; optionally follows the window's Space color; never in private tabs; inks checked at 4.5:1 in a pure paint module.
Desktop only. Opens blanc.day's page for a feature release once after the update, only when the page exists; the Start Page pill links to it.

Desktop only. Off by default, device-local. Idle ungrouped, unpinned tabs close into a per-profile Archive kept 30 days, restorable from the Quick Switcher and History; never private tabs, never synced, cleared with history.
Desktop only (D11). Two to four tabs side by side, one row in the tab list, saved with the session and Spaces; grown out of Glance; one Island plus a header per pane.
